notes.title: The Pit Arena mode is now open!
notes.content:
[h3]Round-Based Arena Mode[/h3]

The Pit has now opened up its arena to regular fights, which means you can sign up for a chance to go through all 12 rounds in one go, to gain a reward as well as the throne-holder title.

If you die or quit in any of the rounds you will be ejected from the Arena and will have to start from Round 1! 

To access this round-based arena mode, you will need to have access to The Pit and have defeated Donovan 'Ribcage' Campbell. 
Talk to the Pit Overseer to sign up for the arena - only 100 CorpCreds! [i]wow![/i]

To accommodate for this extra mode, a few changes to the combat were made

[h3]Combat Changes[/h3]

- Blocking will now take into account the angle of the attacker, meaning you won't be able to negate damage even if they're attacking you from behind or off to the side.
- Attacking while blocking (jab punch) can now only be done if you're less than 80% Fatigued.
- Blocking attacks will now increase Fatigue.
- Riposte after a parry is faster
- Parrying (blocking just before an attack) doesn't affect Fatigue

The reason for these changes is to make combat a bit more challenging and the reward the sweeter. I was very lenient from the start since I was a bit worried players would find the combat either annoying or too hard or both, but now this arena is a chance to warm up and get used to the combat.
But of course, during the main story the choice is always there to ignore combat and let everyone else do the fighting for you.

[h3]Other[/h3]

- Audio settings/motion blur slider should no longer reset between different sessions/choosing different levels.
- Fixed environment models missing some faces in the Arboretum level.
- Slightly changed The Pit arena ground to have less protruding geometry so it's smoother to move around in it.
- Fixed some player ragdoll issues due to the previous update.
- Fixed Jackson's computer not properly deactivating prior menus.
- Added U-Fix injection SFX

On a final note, it's been really motivational reading all the recent positive reviews. I messed up alot on launch due to stress and just a general lack of knowing what I was doing (still d to be fair), but at least now I have room to think on how to approach certain aspects of the game post-launch.

Anyway, I'm not done with it and I'm already working on more extra stuff for the game - next major update maybe end of the year or early next year!

notes.title: New Game+, Level Select, Travel restriction lifted!
notes.content:
Hello!

First - thank you to everyone who has bought the game and supported me in ensuring I could keep working on this as well as future projects! 
This was my first 'big' RPG - I've made many mistakes, both design and feature creep, but learned a lot, so thank you for all the feedback!

Now for the update:

[h3]New Game+[/h3] Has arrived with a little extra - beyond being able to start a new game with all your AGNIS, Skills and Perks intact, you'll be able to get a new ability once you arrive at the Mass Abode building and sleep in your bed.
This New Game+ option will show up in the Main Menu once you beat the game (you will have to either load up a save just before the ending or finish a new game)

[h3]"Choose Level"[/h3] Main Menu option is now available after beating the game. This is just as it says, choose any level that you feel like replaying. This one is just for revisiting and going through a level, some levels may not work properly since they require story information from prior levels that are not available when you play this way.
[i]Also, for anyone that has been here since the beginning, this was an option that broke the game for a day since I left this menu open and people couldn't click on anything and warranted some negative reviews and refunds... ːsteamsadː
Anyway....[/i]

[h3]Travel restriction lifted[/h3] You can now travel using the UnderTram to locations that also have the UnderTram, e.g. Citizen Hub, B-Class Echelon and Arboretum.
From the B-Class Echelon you can travel to the Citizen Hub, and from the Citizen Hub you can go back to the Mines, The Pit or the Boarding Hotel and of course, back to the B-Class Echelon through the UnderTram station.

[h3]Partial Controller Support[/h3] 
Menus now work properly with a controller! Lockpicking works with a controller and will show you the correct bindings!
You will still need a keyboard to input your name and age when creating a character, as well as a mouse for the hacking minigame. I couldn't find a good way to make this work on a controller since it requires some speed to click on the correct numbers, and a controller is a not good way of doing this.
For Steam Deck/ROG Ally users, I think this is a non-issue with the touchscreen?

There were also some minor fixes here and there:

- Fixed an issue with U-Fix Syringe not being thrown correctly
- Mouse Sensitivity now goes down to 0.1 instead of 1
- Fixed sharp weapons knocking enemies out instead of killing them
- FT (Fatigue) now goes down slightly faster
- Fixed enemies sometimes not go aggro if the Player threw a sharp object at them
- Fixed some issues with story progression if Jacquie was killed
- Fixed an issue with Alger not going to the correct spot if he was aggro'd and then deaggro'd.
- Fixed an issue with the objective in the Mines not activating properly

Now, between fixing bugs, I'm now designing an extra mode for the game that'll be available in the Main Menu, alongside New Game+ and the new Choose Level option. 
I'm not sure when this will be out, but If you bought the game, I hope you will enjoy this extra piece of content whenever it's available, as this is for you as a thank you for the support. ːzombiethumbsupː

notes.title: Demo Update 2
notes.content:
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Remade tutorial level to include some more gameplay details.
[*] Added various new SFX to interactable objects and ambient objects.
[*] Added new music track to Derelict Hotel level.
[*] Added NPC markers to the Compass UI.
[*] Added an indicator to the UI for NPCs that are off-screen and alerted/suspicious.
[*] Added an indicator to the UI for a clearer sign on what is and isn't a restricted/hostile area.
[*] Fatigue bar will now pulsate when above 75%.
[*] Made CorpID logs (text pop-ups on the left side of screen) slightly bigger and more logs are colored. Many players are missing information that shows up here.
[*] Small color palette change to menus.
[*] Added new Bench Vise weapon to Derelict Hotel level.
[*] Added 2 weapons - 2-Piece Toaster and 4-Piece Toaster, both found in the Derelict Hotel level.
[*] Slight hand IK adjustments to 2-handed blunt weapons.
[*] Slight adjustment to space out the save system between frames. Instead of trying to save a lot of information in 1 frame - resulting in the game freezing for a second - I spaced it out over 4 frames, resulting in a small stutter as it saves but at least it won't look like the game crashed/about to crash. I can change this back if needed.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed some issues with the Player character stats not being properly set when saving/loading. 
Stats should now properly save and set when loading different saves with different characters. [i]e.g. if you had a character that was Male on your Quicksave but a Female character on your Autosave, both saves will correctly represent the respective Player character.[/i]
[*] Fixed crouch speed not setting properly when loading a save where the player character was crouching.
[*] Fixed some Keypads not working properly.
[*] Fixed some issues with the Pocket system and made it work with the save system; everything should now save and load properly, including the currently equipped weapon.
[*] Fixed an Intuition skill check with the Skulls leader.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Player character  couldn't move if an NPC opened a door as the player character was lockpicking it.
[*] Fixed a water puddle in the Mass Abode building not rendering correctly.
[*] Fixed an issue where lower frame rates could cause the lockpick pointer to behave erratically at the smallest mouse movements. [i]This in turn I think made it much easier to lockpick, so I'll be updating this in the future depending on player feedback.[/i]
[*] Fixed an issue where talking when/while resting and starting a dialogue would make the player character unable to move.
[*] Fixed an issue where pressing the walk button while resting would make the player character slide around the floor. 
[*] Fixed an issue where starting a dialogue with slow walk speed and then ending the dialogue would cause the player character to move at the normal speed while playing the slow walk animation.
[*] Fixed some unintended behaviour during Jackson's dialogue sequence
[*] Fixed some sounds that weren't properly routed through volume channels, meaning pausing the game or changing the volume wouldn't affect these sounds.
[*] Fixed some desynchronization between the NPC's physics puppet rig and Navmesh pathfinding when jumping over obstacles or holes,
[/list]

I've updated the demo 28 times but I'll just keep track of the bigger, more substantial updates like the previous one and this one - demo update 2. It will be the last big one before the game releases!

Thanks for the support
